Our health care workers are facing a mental health crisis.

I am proud the Dr. Lorna Breen Act — which was recently signed into law — is part of the solution and finally gives our health care heroes the mental health resources and treatment they deserve.
https://t.co/nTpKbCTWvb

A free, open, and strong press is crucial to the health of our democracy and the strength of our communities.

As @mcallguild rallies today for higher wages, fair treatment, and a better workplace environment, they have my support.

As teen depression & anxiety rise across the country, @BethlehemAreaSD is taking real steps to prioritize student mental health.

This week, I'm proud my bill to ensure college students have access to mental health resources will be marked up in committee.
https://t.co/puUsGg7kc5

Today, I joined nearly 150 of my colleagues in urging @POTUS to continue taking action to address the nationwide baby formula shortage.

Nutrition is critical to a baby’s development — the Biden Administration & Congress must use every tool we have to get formula back on shelves. https://t.co/rIdBB8O1Nl

Wonderful to host the Castro family in my office, @MicheleCENDALZ is such a terrific advocate working to #EndALZ AND will receive a national award tonight!

I’m proud fight alongside people like Michele for more research funding to improve treatment & find a cure for Alzheimer’s. https://t.co/esRpYEi5gd

America faces an on-going mental health epidemic, fueled in part by a lack of access to mental health services.

Friday, @RepBrianFitz and I reintroduced the Greater Mental Health Access Act to empower those who have lost a loved one to suicide to get treatment and support. https://t.co/tWHC1HsuWG

Great to meet with @Teamsters members today. The Greater Lehigh Valley’s tradition of organized labor goes back generations. I’m committed to carrying that legacy forward by championing the #PROAct to finally ensure that every worker can freely exercise their right to organize. https://t.co/oZ4bsquTe5

September is National Recovery Month. If fighting a mental health or substance use disorder, don't be afraid to ask for help. Recovery is possible.

Find resources at https://t.co/O6e4Olb2DF.

Today, I joined the Harvest Full of Hope Conference on Mental Health. Removing the stigma around mental health cannot just be a slogan. We must create a future where people feel no more shame seeking treatment for a mental health condition than they would a physical health issue. https://t.co/8iRpFD82Zu

On Glioblastoma Awareness Day, we shine a light on the most common, complex, treatment-resistant, and deadliest type of brain cancer. I’m working to bring better treatments and a better quality of life to the over 14,000 people living with this disease.
https://t.co/QLXANVtzQx

Happy #HealthCareAwarenessMonth! On the 1 year anniversary of the #InflationReductionAct that capped seniors' insulin costs at $35/month, empowered Medicare to negotiate drug prices, and helped families save on premiums, I'm keeping up this work to lower the cost of health care.

💉 $510 yearly savings on insulin costs for #PA07 seniors
⚡️ $197,100,000 invested in clean energy projects in Pennsylvania
🩺 $1,370 yearly savings on health care premiums for #PA07 ACA enrollees

The #InflationReductionAct at work!
https://t.co/22dDsv6J5a

I met with @PAAgriculture Sec. Redding to discuss priorities for the 2023 Farm Bill! I’m working to ensure the Farm Bill addresses #PA07’s needs and supports our ag sector—& to pass the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act so our kids get important nutrition & dairy farmers thrive. https://t.co/DtOEFB6tVL

15 years ago, the Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act expanded coverage for mental health and addiction treatment for millions. I’ll keep working to bring mental health care & addiction out of the shadows, and won’t stop until every American can get the care they need. https://t.co/3BkfF6rzEZ

Join me this October in recognizing #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth! Every two minutes a woman is diagnosed with breast cancer; spreading awareness and information can save a life. Learn more about symptoms, risk factors, and screenings below.
https://t.co/5a3A8FAOCO

It was a pleasure to meet with reps. from @LLSusa & two incredible child cancer survivors to discuss the challenges pediatric cancer patients face. I'm proud to cosponsor the Accelerating Kids’ Access to Care Act to help make pediatric cancer treatment more accessible. https://t.co/QtQJ6mdnSR

Narcan saves lives. I applaud Northampton County for hosting these important free training sessions. I’ll continue doing all I can to destigmatize & secure resources for mental health & addiction treatment for all.
https://t.co/rVtwtglSVY

PA has a lower rate of food insecurity than the national average – but I won’t stop working until all families have food on the table. That’s why I’m committed to passing a #FarmBill that prioritizes our farmers & includes critical nutrition assistance for families. https://t.co/4UZNijvdcz

Thanks to tax credits in the Inflation Reduction Act, 4 in 5 Americans can find health care plans for less than $10 a month! For coverage in 2024, be sure to enroll before the deadline. Learn more below.
https://t.co/6oN3fBGz6W

I mourn the passing of Judge Smith. He had so much more left to give to the administration of justice in his courtroom. He will be remembered for his kindness to litigants, his courtesy to attorneys, and his commitment to fair treatment to all under the law.

With reproductive rights under attack, the last thing women should be worried about is their birth control coverage. That’s why I’m joining @RepJudyChu & @DemWomenCaucus to ensure over-the-counter birth control is covered—without cost-sharing, and with no prescription necessary. https://t.co/yjVZoIjqfg

I’m proud of pushing to pass the drug price negotiation program included in the IRA. Now, Pennsylvanians covered by marketplace health insurance coverage will save on average $1,370 in premiums—money going back into the pockets of hardworking families rather than Big Pharma’s.

The Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act passed the House last night! I’m thrilled to have cosponsored and voted to pass this important bipartisan legislation, so our kids can get the nutrition they need and our dairy farmers can thrive. https://t.co/EK7b7aKitX

For many adults, surveillance colonoscopies can help reduce the risk of colorectal cancer by almost 50%. That’s why I’m urging the @HHSGov to classify these colonoscopies as preventative treatments, allowing these exams to be fully covered by your insurance.
